boundaries.name: compiler_refinement
boundaries.obligation: No extraction or simulation of the Rust compiler, Plonky2 target allocator/constraint graph, generated CircuitData, witness writers/panics or proof backend. constructorProgram is an ordered macro transcript; CircuitConstraints is handwritten denotation.

boundaries.name: field_gate_lowering
boundaries.obligation: FieldGateLowering must establish canonical u32/u63 ranges, safe Boolean truth values, zero/product/equality/connect/select semantics, and no-wrap active sum for the actual field. Native integer-to-field and field-to-canonical-u64 conversions must agree.

boundaries.name: recursive_balance_verifier
boundaries.obligation: Constant supplied Balance VK digest+cap, exact cyclic tail shape/decoding, and recursive proof verification must satisfy RecursiveVerifierContract. The Balance relation itself is not proved economically sound by this module.

boundaries.name: native_verification_and_decode
boundaries.obligation: BalanceProofView's cyclicKeyCheck/nativeVerification/nativeDecode and parsed fields must equal actual check_cyclic_proof_verifier_data, VerifierCircuitData.verify, and BalanceFullPublicInputs decode results. The flags are dependency results, not proofs of authenticity.

boundaries.name: merkle_path_and_sparse_tree
boundaries.obligation: MerkleContract is data-only. CanonicalEmptyRoot requires the one canonical height-32 empty-root equality. PathReplacementAt and RowPathContracts require exact u32-index, same-path zero-to-amount replacement only for the finite concrete visited tree/path/key/amount tuples of the checked statement; inactive rows need no replacement premise. No global all-AssetMap update, opening or injectivity law is supplied. Actual SparseMerkleTree operations, scoped collision resistance and canonical encode/path representation are unproved. Nat-index semantic maps use the canonical zero extension outside the u32 key space.

boundaries.name: hash_codec_agreement
boundaries.obligation: HashImplementationAgreement must connect actual native/target Keccak word-to-byte order, PrivateState Poseidon word order, ExtendedPublicState Poseidon-to-Bytes32 canonical conversion and field encodings. 92/21/48 word layouts are proved, not hash implementations.

boundaries.name: scoped_commitment_and_root_binding
boundaries.obligation: KeccakBindingAt, PrivateCommitmentBindingAt, ExtendedCommitmentBindingAt and TreeRootBindingAt are explicit scoped collision/binding premises for compared encodings. They are not global axioms or automatic crypto proofs.

boundaries.name: native_static_types_and_full_private_state
boundaries.obligation: ChannelStateMirror.NativeTyped and witness u8/u32/U256/fixed-array/native-state domains correspond to Rust types. FullPrivateState root extraction, private tree ownership, typed field serialization and native path generation must refine the supplied functions.

boundaries.name: caller_authentication_finality_and_economics
boundaries.obligation: This file does not verify N-of-N signatures, latest H, whole close-state identity, L1 finality/freeze, encrypted member balances, withdrawal liveness, ledger high-water or send-cursor completeness. Those are independent caller/Balance/close-contract proof obligations, not established by the conditional asset-vector theorems.
